answer.says: Ramesh, the body insists. Please put a plate together for me: the rice, the dal, and an egg. I have walked three kilometres and my spirit is currently subordinate to my stomach.
answer.thought: Jacobi was right that a hungry man does not imagine food but eats it. I am that man. The abstraction of my theses must wait until the concrete hunger is abrogated.
